title: Vectors: DTN S-flag/HBH expiry wire format (spec 05-routing 9.8, Type=0x03)
description: Remaining verifiable slice of b7z9.8. The C implementation (router.c IPV6_HBH_OPT_DTN 0x03, data len 5, S flag 0x80, expiry u32 BE) and the wall-clock fail-open wiring (coap_dtn.c dtn_wall_clock) landed; Rust and Python consumers are absent (separate parity beads). Create test/vectors/dtn_sflag_hbh.json — spec-derived independent oracle from spec/05-routing.md 9.8 (option layout, S flag 0x80, reserved-ignored-on-receive, absolute expiry u32 BE, clockless fail-open MUST) — plus schema validation via python/tests/test_vectors.py. C/Rust/Python consumers are follow-ups.
close_reason: Spec-derived vectors created: test/vectors/dtn_sflag_hbh.json (bare-array root, gcp_vector-compatible schema branch) — 7 cases covering S-flag set/clear, reserved-bits-ignored-on-receive, expiry BE decode, expired-with-valid-clock drop, R-05-080 clockless fail-open, wrong-length rejection. Independent oracle is the spec text (05-routing 9.8 wire diagram); values hand-computed, no implementation-derived bytes; registered in python/tests/test_vectors.py schema gate (803 pass). C consumer already landed (router.c 0x03 path + coap_dtn.c wall-clock fail-open = the other half of parent b7z9.8). Rust/Python consumer parity filed as separate beads. Reviews: kimi-k3 timed out 2x (600s/180s) -> self-review fallback: hex values hand-verified against the spec layout, schema validated, no code paths touched.
